summary:
Most U.S. health insurers will remain profitable despite the Covid-19 pandemic, according to research by Moody's Investors Service.

On April 15, the industry giant said revenue for the first three months of the year was more than $64 billion, up from just more than $60 billion last year. The company topped earnings expectations, coming in at $5 billion, up slightly from the same period a year earlier.
